summary: Adds a Flask search endpoint and a Stripe config file. It also changes items pagination, the Dockerfile, the CI workflow, the deploy script and the lodash version.

findings.title: Search query built from request input
findings.problem: search_items puts the q request argument straight into the SQL text with an f-string. Nothing escapes or binds q.
findings.consequence: Any caller of /search can inject SQL and read every table in items.db.
findings.fix: Pass q to cur.execute as a bound parameter with a question mark placeholder.
findings.suggested_change: cur.execute("SELECT id, name, price FROM items WHERE name = ?", (q,))

findings.title: Stripe secret key committed to source
findings.problem: config.py hard-codes a Stripe API key as a string literal. Everyone with repository access can read the key.
findings.consequence: Anyone holding the key can make payment API calls on the shop account.
findings.fix: Revoke the key in Stripe. Read STRIPE_KEY from an environment variable or a secret store instead.

findings.title: Pagination offset skips the first page
findings.problem: list_items now computes offset as page times PAGE_SIZE. Page 1 therefore starts at row 20 instead of row 0.
findings.consequence: Clients never see the first 20 items. Every page is shifted forward by one page.
findings.fix: Restore the offset formula that subtracts one from page.

findings.title: Pull request title interpolated into shell script
findings.problem: The new step expands the pull request title directly into the run script. A title with shell syntax runs as commands on the runner.
findings.consequence: Any pull request author can execute arbitrary code in CI.
findings.fix: Pass the title through an env entry and reference it as a quoted shell variable.

findings.title: lodash downgraded to a vulnerable release
findings.problem: The change downgrades lodash from 4.18.1 to 4.17.15. Version 4.17.15 has known command injection, prototype pollution and ReDoS flaws.
findings.consequence: Front-end code that uses lodash becomes exposed to these published flaws.
findings.fix: Keep lodash at 4.18.1 in package.json and package-lock.json.

findings.title: Container now runs as root
findings.problem: The change removed the USER 10001 line and the useradd step. The Flask server now runs as root inside the container.
findings.consequence: Any code execution bug in the app, such as the search injection, gets root inside the container.
findings.fix: Restore the non-root user creation and the USER 10001 line before CMD.

findings.title: Base image changed from pinned to latest
findings.problem: The change replaces the pinned python:3.12.7-slim-bookworm image with python:latest. Each build can pull a different Python major release.
findings.consequence: Builds become unreproducible and can break when a new Python release ships. CI tests 3.12, so they no longer match the image.
findings.fix: Pin the image to an explicit Python release tag.

findings.title: pip cache kept in the image
findings.problem: The change dropped the --no-cache-dir flag from pip install. The pip download cache now stays in the image layer.
findings.consequence: The image grows by the size of every downloaded wheel.

findings.title: Unquoted deploy directory in rm
findings.problem: The rm command now expands DEPLOY_DIR without quotes. A path with spaces splits into several arguments.
findings.consequence: The script can recursively delete unrelated directories on the deploy host.
findings.fix: Quote the variable and keep the empty-value guard.

findings.title: Deploy loop parses ls output
findings.problem: The loop now iterates over unquoted ls output. Names with spaces split apart, and the loop prints bare names instead of full paths.
findings.consequence: The deploy log shows wrong or partial file names.

findings.title: Changed endpoints have no covering test
findings.problem: The repository has no tests for the new search endpoint or the changed list_items pagination.
findings.consequence: Regressions like the pagination offset error reach users unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for /search and for the first page of /items.
